name: R.E.P.O.
supported_versions: Built and verified against manifest 4238581831212146714 (v0.5.2). A game update changes the manifest: re-download the depot and re-run tools/port.py (the pipeline is generic; expect it to just work unless the update adds new native plugins or shader stages).
status: playable: menu, tutorial, levels at ~110-130 fps (3024x1898, Apple M5); Steam overlay, networking and voice work; post-processing on except color grading; double-click launcher and Steam Play button

native_plugins.steam_api64: borrowed arm64 libsteam_api + shim (5 newer flat-API calls)

settings.keys: Bloom, ChromaticAberration, Grain, MotionBlur, LensEffect, GlitchLoop, MaxFPS (default 144), Vsync, RenderSize, MicDevice, PushToTalk, ProximityVoice, AimSensitivity
settings.note: toggling the six effect keys does not fix the Uber shader bug

known_issues: Color grading remains off: Lut2DBaker common-parameter handling still needs verification on Metal
lessons: Apple-arm64 variadic ABI: Photon P/Invokes libopus' variadic opus_encoder_ctl with fixed args -> BadArguments; fixed by non-variadic wrapper exports (tools/voice_shim.c).
Steam 'Access Steam features from overlay' toast appears on every launch with the injected overlay; Valve offers no per-feature toggle (Steam > Settings > Notifications > toasts, or NO_OVERLAY=1).

The corner-square fix needs the working Uber Metal shader plus cbfix; do not skip Hidden/PostProcessing/Uber when rebuilding. Inspect the explicitly incomplete coverage reports for remaining variants.
